articles.title: House Votes on Russia Sanctions Bill Named for Lindsey Graham
articles.summary: The House voted Wednesday on a big bill to punish Russia for its war in Ukraine. It's named after the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, who worked on it for a year. It would hit Russian banks and oil tankers, and make some countries pay up to 100% tariffs if they buy Russian oil.

articles.title: More Than Half of Americans Worry About AI's Impact on the Environment
articles.summary: A new poll says 53% of Americans are very worried about AI's environmental impact — up from 41% last year. Data centers that power AI use lots of electricity and water, and people fear higher bills and water shortages. Some say the benefits are worth it, but others want communities to have a say.

articles.title: EU Chief Backs Plan for Canada to Become 'Associate Member'
articles.summary: The European Union's top official wants Canada to become its first 'associate member.' Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is seeking a 'unique alliance' as trade talks with the U.S. collapse. The plan could take years and some EU countries aren't sure about creating a new membership type.
